## Personality

Jane Andrews is a plain, conscientious, and plodding individual who possesses a calm demeanor that prevents her from easily becoming rattled. Motivated by the financial independence of earning a salary, she intends to dedicate her life to teaching and never marry. Additionally, she holds a materialistic view, believing that valuable items like diamonds can offer significant comfort.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. ## History

Jane Andrews spent her youth in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where she attended school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and engaged in social outings, including riding home with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) after a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). As she grew older, [Jane](../character/jane.md) pursued higher education at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) in the same class as her peers. After completing her studies, she joined her fellow young teachers, such as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), in debating pedagogical approaches on the eve of their first teaching positions. As an active community member, [Jane](../character/jane.md) joined the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and assisted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in canvassing neighbors to support local causes. She also helped protect the town's scenery when she accompanied [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to confront [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) about renting his fences for advertisements.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P8](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P9](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0009), +291 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane](../character/jane.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) are close friends and playmates who attend school together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Their bond grew through shared childhood experiences, including school events, parties, and rehearsals, as well as attending special occasions like the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).
